messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-11-03] standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2: Heads-up from the Boreal team: the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2: Boreal saw that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2025-04-18] standup/boreal/2025-04-18: Deploys to the event bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-18] standup/boreal/2025-12-18: Rotation day for Boreal: Marcus hands the pager to Lena. Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-05-22] standup/boreal/2025-05-22: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-02-05] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Incident review INC-2025-004. The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. Root cause: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-scheduler: Handover: as of today scheduler moves from the Ember team to the Dune team. Oskar walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.

Question: Who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17.

Relevant entries:
- [2025-01-09] Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-06-11] handover: notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today (2025-06-11).
- [2025-06-27] correction: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. Cinder never owned it.

So on 2025-05-17, before the 2025-06-11 handover, Boreal owned the notifier ("Boreal kept it until today" referring to 2025-06-11). So on 2025-05-17, the notifier was owned by Boreal.
